requirements.evidence: Contract met: CallMode enum with exact cases (app/Enums/CallMode.php:6-10), NoWaitingTicketsException extends RuntimeException (app/Exceptions/NoWaitingTicketsException.php:7), invokable action with the specified signature (app/Actions/CallNextTicket.php:25). Queue row locked and is_active read from the locked row (:29-32); fairness looks at last 3 by called_at desc, id desc and requires all 3 priority plus a waiting normal (:37-54); ordering per mode (:62-74); candidate re-locked and status re-checked, skipping called ones (:77-89); only status/called_at/called_by_user_id set (:81-84); dedicated exception when nothing eligible (:92). Small edge: when fairness forces NormalOnly and the waiting normals were concurrently called, it throws instead of falling back to priority (:52-53, :92). Docs updates are thin (docs/architecture.md:103, docs/business-rules.md:131).

conventions.evidence: Domain write is correctly an Action (app/Actions/CallNextTicket.php). But the project's TDD convention ("No production code without a test; everything implemented ships with a test") is ignored: no test file in the diff. CHANGELOG.md [Unreleased] not updated although conventions require it. Docs edits exist but only describe the action at a high level rather than the ordering/fairness implementation details.

security.evidence: Task explicitly excludes authorization (caller trusted). No mass assignment: attributes set individually (app/Actions/CallNextTicket.php:81-84). Row locks for queue (:29) and candidate (:79) inside DB::transaction (:27) prevent double calls; no user input or output rendering involved.

tests.evidence: No tests in change.diff for any of the new behavior (modes, ordering tie-breaks, fairness, inactive queue, no-eligible exception, concurrency skip, write-once).

simplicity.evidence: Single action with direct Eloquent queries, no extra layers. Minor duplication of the ordering chain in the Any and PriorityOnly branches (app/Actions/CallNextTicket.php:64, :67-68); the separate $hasNormal exists() query is reasonable.

readability.evidence: Clear names ($lockedQueue, $effectiveMode, $priorityStreak) and step comments (app/Actions/CallNextTicket.php:28, :34, :57, :76). Reassigning the loop variable $candidate to the locked instance (:79) with a redundant @var is slightly confusing; filler comment in the exception class (app/Exceptions/NoWaitingTicketsException.php:9).

scope.evidence: Diff touches only the action, enum, exception and the two docs sections the task names; no unrelated edits.

issues.explanation: The action ships with no Pest tests at all, violating the project's mandatory test-first rule and leaving ordering, fairness, inactive-queue, exception and concurrency-skip behavior unverified.
Conventions require a CHANGELOG entry under [Unreleased] for the change; none was added.
Doc additions are generic summaries and do not describe the implemented ordering tie-breaks, mode filters or how the fairness history is computed as the task asks.

If fairness forces NormalOnly but the waiting normals are called concurrently via Ticket::call() before being locked, the loop ends with NoWaitingTicketsException instead of continuing with priority tickets as the rule 'if no normal is waiting, priority tickets keep being called' implies.
Overwriting the cursor's $candidate with the locked re-fetch (plus a redundant @var) obscures the distinction between the candidate and its locked copy.
Filler comment '// No additional functionality needed.' adds nothing.

review.summary: Adds the CallNextTicket action, CallMode enum and NoWaitingTicketsException. The logic covers queue locking, the active check, per-mode ordering, the fairness rule and exactly-once re-checking, and it matches the contract. However, there are no tests at all, despite the project's mandatory TDD convention, and the CHANGELOG and detailed docs are missing, so it needs changes before merging.
